title: Quadbridge Product Studio
intentBasis: User authorized the local full architecture program and on 2026-10-01 requested a reusable architecture-first Brain with visual planning, core prioritization and continuous review. Existing source architecture and bounded execution contracts remain authoritative.

vision.destination: Build and operate reviewed products through a product-neutral Studio, with exact composition, immutable artifacts, domain ownership and understandable user journeys.
users: Project owner reviewing direction and delivery
nonGoals: Claiming production or bug-free status from local checks

successSignals.label: Core journey acceptance
successSignals.definition: Candidate-specific demonstration of each required user journey with blocked and unrun checks retained.

successSignals.label: Delivery cycle time
successSignals.definition: Elapsed time from agreed ready point to accepted core outcome, reporting blocked time separately.

successSignals.label: Review rework
successSignals.definition: Revisions after a defined independent review point, with causes.

successSignals.label: Escaped defects
successSignals.definition: Confirmed defects discovered after the defined acceptance boundary and exposure window.

policy.coreFirst: Finish the next coherent user journey and its essential correctness before speculative breadth. Current execution selection comes from .brain/CURRENT.md, not a copied next-action label.
reviewCadence: After source or contract change that affects the plan
After actual check or review results
At a meaningful drift or repeated-failure finding
nonNegotiables: Keep neutral packages independent of domain modules and product wiring.
Preserve actor/product/instance/tenant/command identity and owner databases.
Build before source tests; preserve failed, blocked and unrun evidence.
Offline views gain no filesystem/build privileges.
Existing source catalogues remain authoritative; this atlas is not an allowed-module list.
policy.deferRule: Defer optional polish, speculative generalization and unrelated edge campaigns with a reason and revisit trigger. A concrete violation of the current outcome or essential invariant stays core.
